author: pixel-foundation
description:
pixel-foundation data
	

Processed training / evaluation data of the pixel-foundation project: vision tasks
(perception, low-level, 3D) whose outputs are encoded as RGB images and learned by
image-generation / editing models. Each subset = one source dataset, in a unified
record format with the raw ground truth (boxes, masks, depth in meters, normals, flow,
disparity, camera, ...). The RGB encoding of targets is done online at training time;
the preview column shows one such… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/pixel-foundation/pixel-foundation-data.
